verdict.rationale: Cooley GO's document generators and Cooley AI handle user-supplied data, so user control over retention and deletion is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence describes any retention setting, deletion workflow, or data-control feature. The Cyber/Data/Privacy practice page describes legal advisory services to clients, not a product capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
